title: Tajiri, Super Crazy & Guido reshape the undercard
summary: Tajiri and Super Crazy’s contrasting styles create a recurring rivalry, with Little Guido adding a third technical threat. Their encounters become a dependable showcase in late-era ECW.

chapters.title: Tajiri wins the first pay-per-view meeting
chapters.context: Sharp kicks meet fast aerial offense in a pairing ECW will revisit.

chapters.title: Super Crazy wins the rematch
chapters.context: The reversal keeps the rivalry balanced and gives Crazy a pay-per-view victory.

chapters.title: Guido joins the three-way contest
chapters.result: Tajiri defeats Super Crazy and Little Guido.
chapters.context: The three-way format combines striking, aerial wrestling and submissions in the same rivalry.
